prompts.name: 汎用
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Project asset for ARCANA dark fantasy card RPG. Create a production sprite atlas of exactly 40 DIFFERENT detailed painterly trading-card illustrations, perfectly regular 5 columns by 8 rows. Square 2048x2048 canvas. Each cell is a landscape 8:5 scene. No gutters, no margins, no borders, no labels, no text, no typography. Each illustration strictly isolated inside its cell, important subject centered with generous breathing room; never crosses cell boundary. All scenes underground arcane ruins, cinematic rim light, rich material detail, no people, no faces or hands. THEME: travelers alchemy, antique gold, teal, survival tools; no weapons as main motif.
Rows 1-4 are recovery/energy restoration scenes, read left to right: 1 swirling breath around a vessel, 2 luminous energy conduit, 3 still meditation pool and focus gem, 4 coiled stored power in artifact, 5 fallen relic rekindling; 6 twin linked vessels exchanging power, 7 circular stream through stone channels, 8 glowing heart crystal, 9 echoing energy rings over tool, 10 arcane wire joining cores; 11 flash of light captured in bottle, 12 ornate restorative potion, 13 pulsing crystal cluster, 14 two-color energy conversion prism, 15 reverse waterfall feeding orb; 16 sacrificial chalice with crimson drop, 17 relic waking in brilliant aura, 18 surging fountain of magic, 19 shattering seal releases power, 20 life vein light in broken stone.
Rows 5-8 are expendable single-use relics, read left to right: 21 melting wax seal, 22 mysterious trump talisman, 23 oath ribbon tied to relic, 24 secret burning sigil tablet, 25 last ember in brazier; 26 star fragment, 27 paper protective charm, 28 splintering crystal, 29 forbidden book, 30 prayer stone; 31 broken seal chains, 32 fading musical magical vortex, 33 torn spell page, 34 sacred ash urn, 35 glowing moon drop; 36 last testament scroll, 37 cracked glowing jewel, 38 revelation shining from relic, 39 etched sacrificial token, 40 final lantern extinguishing in sparks.
Include theme motif subtly in EVERY scene, weapons as still objects only where appropriate. Distinct composition for each tile, full color, luminous focal objects, not flat icons or simple geometric emblems. Precisely aligned 5x8 grid.
